title: About Coffeedant
bodyHtml:
Your Trusted Coffee Outfitter

I'm Aleksandar Spasevski. I hunt the world's best beans and test every espresso machine worth your money.

At 35, I've pulled thousands of shots, cupped hundreds of origins, and torn apart dozens of machines to understand what makes exceptional coffee at home.

What You Get Here

Bean Reviews That Matter
Origin details, roast profiles, extraction notes. Real taste tests, not marketing copy. I source directly from roasters who care about transparency and quality.

Machine Testing Without BS
Every grinder, espresso machine, and brewer gets the full treatment. Measured extraction times, temperature stability tests, maintenance requirements. You'll know exactly what 20-bar pressure means for your morning crema.

Guidance That Works
Grind settings for your beans. Dose weights that deliver. Temperature curves that extract properly. Skip the trial and error.

Why Trust Coffeedant

I buy the gear. I drink the coffee. No sponsored content disguised as reviews.

Every recommendation comes from actual use—months of daily brewing, not unboxing videos. When a machine breaks at month three or beans arrive stale, you'll hear about it.

For Every Coffee Drinker

New to Espresso
Start with proven entry machines. Learn the fundamentals without the $3,000 investment.

Daily Brewers
Consistent, reliable setups that deliver. Subscription-worthy beans that ship fresh.

Coffee Obsessed
Premium single origins, precision grinders, temperature-profiling machines. The tools that turn good coffee into exceptional coffee.

The Coffeedant Promise

Fresh beans, delivered on schedule. Honest reviews backed by data. Equipment recommendations based on actual long-term use.

No fluff. Just better coffee at home.
